address: 102, Chenggong 2nd Street, Zhubei City, Hsinchu County, Taiwan
bio: For well over a decade, this venue has been the place to go for authentic Italian food made with local and Italian ingredients. From handmade pasta to creative takes on Italian classics, the rotating menu unveils a lineup of stellar dishes, packed in oomph and underpinned by refined craftsmanship and exquisite plating. The wine list boasts over 450 labels to the joy of wine buffs. For a sweet finale, try their freshly made tiramisu.
